text: dsh-opencode-provider 是 DSH 模型接入插件，将 opencode-local provider 注册到 Harness。它把对话序列化后发送给本机 OpenCode server，并将 SSE 文本事件转换为 DSH 流式输出。支持取消、超时、重试策略和上下文及输出长度配置。适合希望在 DSH 中使用本地 OpenCode 模型的用户；需要 Node.js 22 和 OpenCode server，默认不需单独的 provider API key。

dsh-opencode-provider connects DSH to a local OpenCode server as a model provider. It sends conversation text and maps SSE events to DSH output, with cancellation and timeout handling. Configure retries and output limits. Requires Node.js 22 and OpenCode; no provider API key by default.
想把本机 OpenCode 里的模型接到 DSH 使用。
DSH 能不能通过 OpenCode 服务生成流式文本回复？

让 DSH 把系统提示和历史消息一起交给本地模型处理。
希望模型回答能边生成边显示，而不是等整段完成。
怎么让 DSH 请求超时或取消时中断正在进行的模型会话？
我想给 OpenCode provider 设置默认上下文容量和每次输出上限。

dsh-opencode-provider 的功能「OpenCode 模型接入」：注册 opencode-local provider，按生成请求创建 session 并发送文本对话，供 DSH 获取模型回复。
dsh-opencode-provider 的功能「流式文本转换」：订阅 OpenCode SSE 事件并将文本增量映射为 DSH 文本块；收到结束事件后结束输出，适用于逐步展示模型回复。
dsh-opencode-provider 的功能「连接与生成参数配置」：在插件配置中可设置服务 baseURL、上下文窗口、输出 token 上限、发现用模型列表和 retry policy；未提供时采用代码中的默认连接参数。
dsh-opencode-provider 的功能「取消与超时收尾」：请求携带的 abort signal 会传递给网络操作；超时、取消或流错误时会尝试中断 OpenCode session，避免请求一直等待。
dsh-opencode-provider README · dsh-opencode-provider：Use models available through a local [OpenCode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) server inside DeepSeek Harness without a DeepSeek API key.

dsh-opencode-provider README · Architecture：```
DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
  └─ LLM Runtime
       └─ opencode-local provider route
            └─ OpenCodeAdapter (dsh-opencode-provider)

The adapter serializes the full DSH conversation (system prompt + messages) into a single prompt string, sends it to the OpenCode server, and translates the SSE event stream into DSH `StreamChunk` values. OpenCode runs its own internal agent/tool loop, so the adapter exposes **text output only** — structured DSH tool calling is not available.

dsh-opencode-provider README · Verified Features：- **No API key required** — connects to a local OpenCode server over plain HTTP
- **Streaming** — text deltas are delivered as they arrive
- **Cancellation** — abort signal tears down the SSE stream and interrupts the session
- **Timeouts** — configurable SSE establishment (10 s), prompt admission (10 s), and terminal completion (120 s) limits
- **Retry policy** — provider-level retry config forwarded to DSH runtime
- **Live SSE event formats** — handles both legacy (`session.text.delta`, `session.execution.succeeded`) and current (`session.next.text.delta`, `session.next.step.ended`) event envelopes
- **Graceful fallback** — unknown SSE events are skipped; non-JSON lines are ignored; `data.wrapper` envelopes are unwrapped defensively

dsh-opencode-provider README · Requirements：- **Node.js** ≥ 22
- **OpenCode server** running locally (default: `http://127.0.0.1:4096`)
- **DeepSeek Harness** ≥ 0.1.0-rc.8

dsh-opencode-provider README · Via DSH plugin command：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-provider
```

dsh-opencode-provider README · From source checkout：```bash
git clone https://github.com/goku54477/dsh-opencode-provider.git
cd dsh-opencode-provider
pnpm dsh
```

dsh-opencode-provider README · Quick Start：1. Start the OpenCode server:

```bash
opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4096
```

2. The adapter auto-configures with the default base URL (`http://127.0.0.1:4096`). No additional setup is needed.

3. In DeepSeek Harness, select the model:

```
opencode-local/mimo-v2.5-free
```

dsh-opencode-provider README · Configuration：All fields are optional. Defaults work out of the box with a local OpenCode server.

```yaml

dsh-opencode-provider README · Inside your DSH cordis.yml or plugin config：llm-opencode:
  # Endpoint of the OpenCode server
  baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:4096"

# Context window reported to the harness (default: 128000)
  defaultContextWindow: 128000

# Max output tokens per request (default: 16384)
  maxTokens: 16384

# Advisory model list for discovery consumers
  models:
    - id: mimo-v2.5-free
      name: mimo-v2.5-free
      description: "OpenCode local agent (text output only)"
      contextWindow: 128000

dsh-opencode-provider README · How It Works：1. **Session creation** — `POST /api/session` with `{ model: { id, providerID: "opencode" } }`
2. **Concurrent SSE + prompt** — the adapter fires the SSE subscription (`GET /api/session/{id}/event`) and prompt delivery (`POST /api/session/{id}/prompt`) concurrently. This avoids a deadlock where the OpenCode server withholds SSE headers until the session has activity.
3. **Conversation serialization** — the full DSH conversation is formatted as `[System]
...

[User]
...

[Assistant]
...` and embedded in the prompt.
4. **Event translation** — SSE events (`session.text.delta`, `session.next.step.ended`, `session.execution.succeeded`, etc.) are mapped to DSH `StreamChunk` types (`block-start`, `text-delta`, `block-end`, `finish`).
5. **Cleanup** — on completion, error, or abort, the adapter sends a best-effort interrupt to the session.
dsh-opencode-provider README · Development：```bash
dsh-opencode-provider README · Build：npm run build
dsh-opencode-provider README · Type-check：npm run typecheck
dsh-opencode-provider README · Run tests：npm run test
dsh-opencode-provider README · Build + test：npm run check

dsh-opencode-provider README · Clean output：npm run clean
```

dsh-opencode-provider README · Security Warning：This plugin communicates with a **local HTTP server** (no TLS by default). Do not expose the OpenCode server to untrusted networks. The default binding (`127.0.0.1`) restricts access to the local machine.

dsh-opencode-provider README · Platform Compatibility：v0.1.0 has been tested on the following exact environment:

| Component | Version |
|-----------|---------|
| OS | Windows 11 |
| Node.js | 22.23.2 |
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.1.0-rc.8 |
| OpenCode | 1.18.19 |
| Model | opencode/mimo-v2.5-free |

Other platforms, Node versions, harness releases, OpenCode versions, and models have not been verified. The adapter may work elsewhere, but no guarantees are made.

dsh-opencode-provider README · Limitations：- **Text output only** — OpenCode runs its own agent/tool loop. Structured tool calling exposed by DSH is not available through this adapter.
- **No multimodal support** — the adapter reports `inputModalities: ["text"]` only. Image/audio/video inputs are not forwarded.
- **Single model advertised** — the default catalog lists `mimo-v2.5-free`. Adding models requires manual config; the adapter does not dynamically discover available models from the server.
- **Prompt size** — the entire conversation is serialized into a single prompt string. Very long conversations may exceed the model's context window.
- **No persistent sessions** — each `stream()` call creates a fresh OpenCode session. Conversation state is not preserved across requests.
- **Local-only by default** — the adapter expects the OpenCode server on `127.0.0.1`. Remote servers require manual `baseURL` configuration and appropriate network access.
